title: Update AI generator UI for 40-question limit and PDF scan uploads
body:
The UI was still enforcing the previous API contract for AI question generation and scan-based exam generation. This updates the teacher AI generator modal to align with the new backend limits and accepted file types.

- **Question count limit**
  - Raise the `questionCount` input cap from `20` to `40`
  - Update client-side validation text to match the new accepted range

- **Scan-based exam generation**
  - Extend the scan upload input to accept PDF files in addition to image formats
  - Update scan upload labels, placeholder text, and empty-state validation copy to reflect image/PDF support

- **Request behavior**
  - Keep the existing `FormData` submission unchanged (`file` is still sent as-is)
  - No request/response mapping changes

```tsx
<input
  type="file"
  accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/jpg,image/webp,application/pdf"
/>

<input
  type="number"
  min={1}
  max={40}
/>
```
